head: b4aea6158a66b00f03209714ece132849e6f88eb
title: Historical balance replays transactions by comparing a plain TIMESTAMP column with a timestamptz snapshot time

bugs.note: transactions.created_at is TIMESTAMP without time zone while the snapshot time and target time are bound as timestamptz, so Postgres converts them using the session TimeZone. In a non-UTC session the window shifts by the offset and the balance at a point in time double counts or skips transactions around the snapshot.
